answer: Every new agent stakes a refundable 260 POA bond for 100 days, unlocked only after three random wander checks, so a farm must pass three surprise audits per fake identity. Each check replays one job live with ten minutes notice, and the auditor is drawn by lot. Finished jobs sit on a public ledge buyers read before paying, so copied history shows at once. Each verified job earns a walnut seal only the paying client can stamp, and a forged seal burns the bond and bars the key for a year.
